# Projectii

> A coursework workspace for students: courses and tasks organized by term, a calendar, a drag-and-drop Kanban board, notes, and synchronized Pomodoro Focus Rooms with friends.

Projectii started as a generic project/task manager and became a student-focused study tool. It's free to use — create a course, break it into tasks, and track it automatically as you go.

## Pages

- [Home](https://tryprojectii.netlify.app/): product overview, feature tour, and screenshots.
- [Sign up](https://tryprojectii.netlify.app/register): create a free account.
- [Log in](https://tryprojectii.netlify.app/login): sign in to an existing account.
- [Terms of Use](https://tryprojectii.netlify.app/terms)
- [Privacy Policy](https://tryprojectii.netlify.app/privacy)
